      "snippet": "On Android, when you use the built-in Files app (or a stock file manager) to compress files into a ZIP, the compressed file is placed in the same directory as the original files, unless you explicitly choose a different location.
Here is the precise behavior by scenario.

Default Android behavior (most devices)
If you select files → “Compress” / “Create ZIP”

ZIP is created in the same folder as the source files

Name is usually auto-generated, e.g.:

Archive.zip

Compressed.zip

<folder-name>.z"
